svg.text: FastWAM / Square: one-shot image intervention (one paired case)
Same physical state + proprio at rollout step 260. B replaces only the first RGB input.
A: original RGB | gripper stays open | task failed
B: demo frame 87 RGB once | gripper closes | first task success at t+113
Times are control steps after intervention (20 Hz). All later inputs are live observations.
Prediction is NOT executed video. PRED t+4 is not identical to ACTUAL t+4; success is from simulator metrics.
Single-case evidence for input sensitivity, not evidence that generated video causes action or that all failures share a cause.
